Condition.description: The condition that causes the trigger to fire.

Schedule.description: Schedule configuration for a time-based trigger.

Expression.description: A cron or rate expression that defines when the trigger fires.

description: Resource Type definition for AWS::DevOpsAgent::Trigger. A trigger defines an automated action that fires on a schedule within an Agent Space.

Action.description: The action to perform when the trigger fires. A JSON object containing actionType and task.

AgentSpaceId.description: The unique identifier of the parent Agent Space.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the trigger. Nested under the parent Agent Space: arn:<partition>:aidevops:<region>:<account-id>:agentspace/<agentspace-id>/trigger/<trigger-id>.

CreatedAt.description: The timestamp when the trigger was created.

Status.description: The status of the trigger. Active triggers fire on schedule; Inactive triggers are paused.

TriggerId.description: The unique identifier of the trigger (assigned by the service on Create).

UpdatedAt.description: The timestamp when the trigger was last updated.
